init_configs: initialize an AllScAIPConfigs dataclass from a flat dictionary of keyword arguments with nested dataclass support
resolve_type_hint: resolve a forward reference string type hint to its actual class object for a given dataclass field
create_AllScAIPConfigs: create an AllScAIPConfigs object that combines global, molecular graph, GNN, and regularization config dataclasses
create_GlobalConfigs: create a GlobalConfigs dataclass to set model hyperparameters like hidden size, num layers, and activation function
create_MolecularGraphConfigs: create a MolecularGraphConfigs dataclass to configure atom limits, KNN parameters, and distance functions for graph construction
